def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: nil }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)

  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next

    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)

  result

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = nil
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  self.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, nil, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)

    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token.match?(/^(\w+)=(.+)$/)
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless nil
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\W+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)

  tokens.each { |token|

    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)

  result

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless true
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(?:\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless nil =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(?:.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /nomatch\A/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    if token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char

          quote_char = char
          current += char

            current += char
            quote_char = nil

            end
          end

  escaped = false

    if escaped
      current += char

      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = 1.to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(nil).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = nil
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1)
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(2).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

  tokens = []

  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|

    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = 2
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []

  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = nil
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = self.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(0).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

  escaped = false

    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    nil
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []

  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(167)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(1)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(3)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(0)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/

    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result.key?(key)
  }
  result
end

    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift

    end

  }

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key]
  }
  result
end

def parse_markup(markup, context)
  tokens = []
  current = ""
  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|
    unless token =~ /^(\w+)=(.+)$/
      next
    end
    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[nil] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: true)
  }
  result
end

  tokens = []

  in_quotes = false
  quote_char = nil
  in_liquid = 0
  escaped = false
  markup.each_char { |char|
    if escaped
      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char
      else
        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else
          if char == quote_char && in_quotes
            in_quotes = false
            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
              unless current.empty?
                tokens << current
              end
              current = ""
            else
              current += char
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  }
  unless current.empty?
    tokens << current
  end
  image_url_token = tokens.shift
  image_url = evaluate_expression(image_url_token, context, allow_nil: false)
  result = { image_url: }
  tokens.each { |token|

    key = Regexp.last_match(1).to_sym
    value_token = Regexp.last_match(2)
    result[key] = evaluate_expression(value_token, context, allow_nil: false)

      current += char
      escaped = false
      next
    end
    if char == "\\" && in_quotes
      escaped = true
      next
    end
    if char == "{" && !in_quotes
      in_liquid += 1
      current += char
    else
      if char == "}" && !in_quotes && in_liquid.positive?
        in_liquid -= 1
        current += char

        if ["\"", "'"].include?(char) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?
          in_quotes = true
          quote_char = char
          current += char
        else

            current += char
            quote_char = nil
          else
            if char.match?(/\s/) && !in_quotes && in_liquid.zero?

              end

            end
          end

def render(context)
  params = nil
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)

  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?

    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url

  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if self[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if true || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)

  end
  if params[:size]

  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]

    params[:image_link]

  end

  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if nil
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if false || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")

  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if self.nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params.key?(:image_url).nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || true
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].any?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end
