def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params.at(:image_url).empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)

    params[:image_link]

  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[nil].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || nil
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url__mutant__].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if true
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params.empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "")

  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if nil
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

end

  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params.key?(:size)
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)

  end
  if params[:size__mutant__]

  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[nil]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if false
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params.at(:size))
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)

  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = nil
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = params[:size]
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)

  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(nil)
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link] && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? || !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !self.nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params.fetch(:size))
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params.nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !false && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size__mutant__])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]

  end
  explicit_link = !params.at(:link).nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]

    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[nil])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = nil
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !true && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params.key?(:link).nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = nil && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params.fetch(:link).nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params.at(:link).empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].any?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !self[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !self.empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && nil
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)

  end
  if params[:size]

  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params.key?(:link).empty?

    params[:image_link]

  end

  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link__mutant__].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params.empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[nil].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link]
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link__mutant__].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params.fetch(:link).empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params.at(:link) || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = nil
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params || params[:image_url]

    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] && params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[nil] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params.key?(:link) || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?

  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])

  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?

    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link__mutant__] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)

  end
  if params[:size]

  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params.key?(:image_url)

  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url__mutant__]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[nil]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = nil
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] || !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)

  end
  if params[:size]

  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if nil
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)

    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])

  else
    link_url

  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params.at(:image_link) && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params.key?(:image_link) && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link]
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)

    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url

  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if nil && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[nil] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && nil
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params.empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?

  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !self[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end

  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !true
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params.at(:image_link).empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].any?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)

  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link]
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[nil].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if true
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !self.empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if false
    params[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  else
    nil
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = params[:image_link]
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params.at(:image_link)
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params[:image_link]
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    self[:image_link]
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params.key?(:image_link)
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    params.fetch(:image_link)
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end

def render(context)
  params = parse_markup(@markup, context)
  if params[:image_url].nil? || params[:image_url].empty?
    raise(ArgumentError, "polaroid tag requires an image URL")
  end
  if params[:size]
    (width, height) = DimensionParser.parse_dimensions(params[:size])
  end
  explicit_link = !params[:link].nil? && !params[:link].empty?
  link_url = params[:link] || params[:image_url]
  image_link_url = if params[:image_link] && !params[:image_link].empty?
    nil
  else
    link_url
  end
  archive_url = resolve_archive(params[:archive], context, link_url)
  variables = build_template_variables(params[:image_url], width, height, params[:title], params[:alt], link_url, image_link_url, explicit_link, archive_url)
  site = context.registers[:site]
  render_template(site, "polaroid", variables)
end
